findings.description: Four stories sit at 8 story points — the agile-standards '8+ MUST SPLIT' threshold. SKILL-6 is T-shirt XL spanning roadmap Phase 7+8 (auth + all UI + progress + admin); SKILL-4 spans Phase 4+6 (loop + catalog + plan).
findings.suggestion: Human judgment, not auto-resolvable. Confirm 8-point stories are acceptable for the hackathon timebox (deliberate 6-story 'protect the loop / freeze' structure, LOC budgets <=~520, sub-tasks already split 3 ways), or split the two widest: SKILL-6 -> auth/roles vs UI, SKILL-4 -> loop vs catalog/plan. Advisory; no content change required to proceed.

findings.description: SKILL-4 / SUB-TASK-3 Failure Condition #3 paraphrases the AC-26 plan-rejection messages ('Pick at least 2 items.' / 'At least one item must be AI-enabled.') instead of the exact spec strings ('Pick at least 2 items for your plan.' / 'Your plan needs at least one AI-enabled item.'). The load-bearing Gherkin and pseudocode already use the exact spec strings.
findings.suggestion: Trivial / auto-resolvable: align the quoted strings in Failure Condition #3 to the exact AC-26/PRD wording. Cosmetic; does not affect implementation or the gate.

review_results.template_compliance: full (business persona, Business Context, Business Rules table, AC Mapping table, Architecture References, UX/Design, DoD, Risks & Assumptions, Progress Log present in all 6 stories; all 18 sub-tasks have >=3-step pseudocode, GOAL/CONSTRAINTS-with-ADR/FORMAT contract, DATA MODELS, 5 ERROR HANDLING, 5 FAILURE CONDITIONS)

human_review_items.description: Four stories at the 8-point split threshold; confirm hackathon-timebox acceptability or split SKILL-6/SKILL-4.
human_review_items.suggested_resolution: Owner acknowledges the deliberate 6-story MVP structure, or splits the two widest stories.
